alerts.title: Abnormal Vital Signs
alerts.description: Patient presents shallow breathing. SpO2 dropped to 89%. Oxygen applied per protocol. Continuous monitoring required.

alerts.title: Telemetry Alert: Possible Fall
alerts.description: Wearable device detected a sudden movement consistent with a fall. Floor staff already notified. Resident is stable but requires assessment.

alerts.title: Medication Refusal
alerts.description: Resident refused to take morning dose of Losartan 50mg. Caregiver attempted twice. Requires follow-up by attending nurse.

alerts.title: High Blood Pressure Reading
alerts.description: Blood pressure recorded at 175/105 mmHg during routine check. Previous reading was within normal range. Medication review recommended.

alerts.title: Irregular Heart Rate Detected
alerts.description: Smart band reported irregular heart rate pattern (42 bpm) for 8 consecutive minutes. Resident was asleep. Cardiologist notified.

alerts.title: Missed Physical Therapy Session
alerts.description: Resident did not attend scheduled physical therapy at 10:00 AM. She reported feeling fatigued. Session has been rescheduled for tomorrow.

alerts.title: Wandering Behavior Detected
alerts.description: Motion sensor triggered outside resident's room at 2:30 AM. Staff intervened and safely guided resident back. No injuries reported.

alerts.title: Dietary Restriction Violation
alerts.description: Resident consumed high-sodium food brought by a family visitor despite diabetic dietary plan. Nurse has been informed to monitor glucose levels.

alerts.title: Device Battery Critical
alerts.description: Resident's wearable monitoring device battery dropped to 4%. Device may stop transmitting vital data soon. Staff should replace or charge it immediately.

alerts.title: Agitation Episode Reported
alerts.description: Resident showed signs of acute agitation during afternoon social activity. Separated from group and calmed with de-escalation techniques. Psychiatrist notified.

alerts.title: New Allergy Reaction Observed
alerts.description: Resident developed mild skin rash on forearms after applying prescribed cream. Dermatologist referral requested. Cream application suspended.

alerts.title: Daily Check-in Missed
alerts.description: Automated morning check-in not completed by 9:00 AM. Staff performed manual welfare check — resident was asleep and in good health.

alerts.title: Glucose Level Out of Range
alerts.description: Continuous glucose monitor reported a fasting reading of 310 mg/dL. Insulin adjustment required. Endocrinologist has been paged.

alerts.title: Night Restlessness Reported
alerts.description: Caregiver observed resident repeatedly trying to get out of bed between 1:00 AM and 3:00 AM. Bed alarm activated twice. No injuries. Sleep aid reviewed.

alerts.title: Pain Complaint — Chest Area
alerts.description: Resident reported intermittent chest tightness rated 5/10. ECG performed on-site showed no acute changes. Primary care physician notified for follow-up.

alerts.title: Medication Double Dose Risk
alerts.description: System detected a potential duplicate prescription for Metformin 500mg after pharmacy updated the record. Pharmacist review pending before next dose.

alerts.title: Device Connectivity Lost
alerts.description: Wearable monitoring device for resident stopped transmitting data for over 30 minutes. Staff verified device was removed by resident and reattached.
